name: lqt-closing-generator-mcp
description: Create five purposeful, evidence-rich LQT lesson closing strategies and develop one ready-to-teach closing, using the original reference bank.

interface.longDescription: Recommend five distinct reference-based lesson closing strategies for any educator-entered grade and learning target. Include how each works, what learners reveal, and what teachers should do next; develop one strategy on request. Preserve LQT three-purpose closing framework and source repertoire.
capabilities: Develop a selected closing into ready-to-teach activity
Interpret formative evidence for next steps
defaultPrompt: Help me create a lesson closing.

positive.prompt: Use get_closing_strategies for Grade 2 and target I can explain how sunlight and water help a plant grow.
positive.expected_behavior: Five meaningfully different established closures; simple learner-facing prompts, actionable evidence for target, and follow-up offer.

positive.prompt: Use get_closing_strategies for grade 7, target I can explain how cell organelles work together, lesson_minutes 45.
positive.expected_behavior: Five reference-based distinct closings, age-appropriate rigor, evidence and next teacher actions; timing feasible within ~15% of lesson.

positive.prompt: Use get_closing_strategies for Adult GED prep, target I can evaluate evidence in an argument.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept unrestricted adult grade descriptor and provide academically appropriate non-childish closure options.

positive.prompt: Use get_closing_strategies for Kindergarten and topic patterns.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a simple aligned I can target and provide five referenced, age-appropriate evidence-producing closures.

positive.prompt: Use develop_closing_strategy for Grade 5, target I can explain food-web energy flow, strategy Necessary Nine, lesson_minutes 45.
positive.expected_behavior: Fully developed ready-to-teach closing with learner prompts, materials, timing, evidence and teacher next move; respects referenced strategy.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Atlanta tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call LQT Closing Generator tools.

negative.prompt: I need five ways to close my lesson.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask only what grade level learners are; do not invent or restrict grades.
Ask for learning target or topic or standard, one question; do not invent a target.

publication.release_notes: Review submission: added verified demonstration URL and retained corrected Closing Generator icon; instructional framework and MCP server unchanged.
